headline: Kenyon paces the NCAC with 54 goals
dek: Kenyon won fifteen matches without a draw, outscoring Ohio Wesleyan, Oberlin, and Wittenberg combined across all competition. Five defeats and nineteen goals conceded never closed the gap the conference's most prolific attack built.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Attacking depth separates the top of the conference from the field: at least fifteen different players scored for Kenyon, spreading its production across the roster rather than leaning on a lone finisher.

wire.line: Denison took just two losses all season, pairing fourteen wins and seven draws with sixteen goals conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four August matches involving Denison and DePauw remain past their scheduled dates without a published result: DePauw against UIndy and Ohio Northern, and Denison against Saint Vincent and Case Western Reserve.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wabash scored 37 goals across the season, yet its ten wins were nearly matched by nine losses and one draw as the defense conceded 27.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Denison goalkeeper Alex Provost posted nine shutouts and stopped 56 shots while allowing thirteen goals, finishing with a 0.812 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oberlin conceded 43 goals while scoring thirteen, allowing more than Denison and Kenyon combined.

last_match.line: The defeat snapped Denison's unbeaten run since September and handed the program its only home loss of the season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
